economy.zh:
**全球市场在科技股抛售与地缘风险中分化调整**

过去24小时，全球风险资产承压，美股科技股因杠杆平仓和估值担忧暴跌，亚洲市场随之波动，但A股逆势放量至2万亿，显示内资韧性。欧洲通胀顽固的信号与消费者信心冰点形成反差，数字欧元则迈出关键一步。此外，SpaceX天量融资和Alphabet入主道指为市场注入结构性看点。

- **科技股恐慌性平仓蔓延**：隔夜美股芯片股领跌，[Cerebras（CBRS）IPO后首份财报披露利润率收缩，跌幅超10%](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/23/cerebras-cbrs-q1-earnings-report-2026.html)，拖累亚洲科技股早盘反弹后回落。Cboe趁势推出[预测市场产品](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/24/vix-owner-cboe-jumps-into-prediction-markets-to-build-on-0dte-growth.html)，试图抓住波动率衍生品增长红利。
- **道指重构与SpaceX巨量融资**：[Alphabet将取代Verizon加入道琼斯工业平均指数](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/23/alphabet-verizon-dow-djia.html)，标志科技权重进一步上升；[SpaceX在IPO后不到两周内通过债务融资250亿美元](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/23/spacex-debt-bond-market-ipo.html)，订单近900亿，反映市场对前沿领域信用资产需求旺盛。
- **欧洲通胀“高烧难退”**：ECB首席经济学家Lane警告，[即便中东达成和平协议，欧元区通胀可能仍保持高位](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxNcGYxbzRqVFlMdjFzLXJBbWF4QWttRGRhS3ptck9XNHZHOUZaQUl6My1LNGJRcVZXTmVoLXZsblpkM191UTk4QWJ5RHVlZ054bXNVMGpYSUYwR1JlaU5IMzBCT2ZQRG9tNlpnejV0LTg2cUlCVmRrUVFPMmxnSkhFV1d2cWk3NlF0MmFxRkxROEg0M1JjdkpuRklFNXZPTjdrTkZDc2Nxd25fTndtYUR0OUVfbWdJTWw4eVJYclhoQ3dzSlowS3Rxag)；[WSJ报道称欧洲消费者因恐惧而缩减开支](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxNVzktaU5FeG1nNnlsekpvN1hjWEVtMWtnY0Z0eWRaNUZuYXk5c204R1A3TFNSRVdRVWZ6M3RIQlZwaE9QZ2dlMjZrOFFtNnNzNGxfUkxsVXpfWUVyaElmTWN6NnVRLUJvTVZ3T1BzU29fT2FyQm9LNDBtcmlKLXNFODZzODFjZkVBWktjQ2lUYmdxRXAtbENlNEFDOXptdzNtb29WSHRCZEpKa2hxWTJmUw)，内需疲弱雪上加霜。
- **A股与港股分化加剧**：A股成交额在午盘前后[突破2万亿元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE5qWWVJNkJyTERmX3FGdjJ0MHN0dDZZVHZ1RGdEZVNqakNoNVhxTExPdm9rRGZFdVVJZzFUNUJHWGZWSjVCdms4QW1CQk9IdjB5elJr)，科创50涨2.48%，但香港中资股因消费担忧[陷入熊市](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxQSlJuc1hrRzQxR2RJVjRTS3JJeU01RU90TnExNnZmcDFaR2xRa0otRnpvVWJZN0d6NDVPM2U0SWFqajF6c3FKX3NmUTFncWxiYjZpLVd4VVNHVVNpRjF1V0R5V0U4eGJtUktULXZQRXJZdGJLa0RyRTQ5cnhtdHRfWjlzWkR6UXcxR0JZS3RqTGtySEVURHZEbmRqM3NNdjlVbVV2anliWnBaWHF0VVE)，[小红书赴港IPO试探市场情绪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE5xUkcxRVA1NGtJTFBESTFZUGhWaXNqbzFLMGFLM29Udk1uMnVkbWV3c09SVG44cDd6eVpkN1EzUXpWNlJUbWlzRU9OY3dTWGhYYlZoamM1b0QxbW9Gd1FqckhXdDBMdnlyckVv)。
- **数字欧元闯关与美联储稳定币新规**：欧盟为摆脱美国信用卡主导，[数字欧元通过关键立法步骤](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxOTFJRQ2FQNjFwNHNoTWZGZ1pvQXZlY2Rib1ZvanNjdDZleU9hTVJVT29UbnNxNDJ1NUlZYldUVGhQUlU3WVhyaUlFRFlYR1YxVGVCMlN6MzU0YlZjQ0h5Sm4yUTRZV1Bldm9uaEthQkF4aDNpc1lGTlVlNTBPbjdyb0owdnp0RW5XNVZMamhPWHh1RzNvRXV5RU9nWEs4bzVGOUVDSTlqWkNYUQ)；同时美联储针对[稳定币发行人客户识别程序征求意见](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20260618a.htm)，监管框架逐步落地。
- **同花顺社区“小作文”事件发酵**：独立分析师Jukan因行情荒谬宣布退出，[引发A股信息生态讨论](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9PQUtDd1U1dXo3VFlodS1wZjdMREdLQnNwTlAwYnVDMlBjQm00Zl9ycFF6QmxUb08tMFFWNjRzQm5hMGlnRXpKY0UxWVZoUUU5RFhoMXotOF9ac2ZJVXJoY2h3)；期货市场上贵金属因加息预期[沪银跌超5%创阶段新低](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9YelhvSlJzZk00LXpkQlpKMlRMejBndzEwOEd0Mm40b0c3a1FEajNod1Uwd0ZZY3luN0ZaNnp5QkJUMTUyTnJCcU4zVzJjYm1GbG9mRDRZTnhHYXRScVE)。

**后续观察**：市场正消化科技股暴力回调与大宗商品下跌的连锁反应。短期焦点在于美联储6月18日发布的稳定币监管征求意见稿会否影响加密资产走势，以及美股财报季开启后AI公司盈利兑现压力是否扩散。欧洲方面，消费者信心能否在石油冲击缓和后企稳将决定ECB下一步降息节奏。A股在政策真空期内的放量能否持续，需警惕增量资金入场的边际变化。
economy.en:
Global markets showed signs of stabilization in early Asian trading on Wednesday after a sharp tech-led selloff in the U.S., while geopolitical and monetary policy developments kept investors on edge. In Europe, the ECB warned that inflation could remain stubborn even with a Middle East peace deal, and the continent's consumers are hoarding cash. China's A-share market saw turnover exceed 2 trillion yuan on surging AI interest, but Hong Kong-listed Chinese stocks slipped into bear territory. The U.S. political landscape is shifting with New York primaries, while Cboe enters prediction markets and Alphabet replaces Verizon in the Dow.

- Global equity futures recovered modestly after a technology rout, triggered by margin unwinding in South Korean chips and weak guidance from Cerebras. [Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq Futures Rise After Chip Stock Selloff](https://news.google.)
- Alphabet's inclusion in the Dow Jones Industrial Average is a symbolic milestone for big tech, replacing telecom stalwart Verizon. [Alphabet added to Dow Jones Industrial Average](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/23/alphabet-verizon-dow-djia.html)
- SpaceX raised $25 billion in debt after nearly $90 billion in orders, underscoring investor appetite for high-growth issuers even in a volatile rate environment. [SpaceX raises $25 billion in debt sale](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/23/spacex-debt-bond-market-ipo.html)
- The ECB's Philip Lane warned that eurozone inflation could stay elevated even if geopolitical tensions ease, complicating the path for rate cuts. [ECB Warns Eurozone Inflation May Stay High](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxNcGYxbzRqVFlMdjFzLXJBbWF4QWttRGRhS3ptck9XNHZHOUZaQUl6My1LNGJRcVZXTmVoLXZsblpkM191UTk4QWJ5RHVlZ054bXNVMGpYSUYwR1JlaU5IMzBCT2ZQRG9tNlpnejV0LTg2cUlCVmRrUVFPM2xnSkhFV1d2cWk3NlF0MmFxRkxROEg0M1JjdkpuRklFNXZPTjdrTkZDc2Nxd25fTndtYUR0OUVfbWdJTWw4eVJYclhoQ3dzSlowS3Rxag)
- Chinese A-share turnover hit 2 trillion yuan for the first time, driven by semiconductor and AI plays, but the rally appears narrow. [A股成交额突破2万亿元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE5qWWVJNkJyTERmX3FGdjJ0MHN0dDZZVHZ1RGdEZVNqakNoNVhxTExPdm9rRGZFdVVJZzFUNUJHWGZWSjVCdms4QW1CQk9IdjB5elJr)
- Hong Kong-listed Chinese stocks entered a bear market on persistent consumer-spending weakness, contrasting with mainland's buoyancy. [China Stocks in Hong Kong Eye Bear Market](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxQSlJuc1hrRzQxR2RJVjRTS3JJeU01RU90TnExNnZmcDFaR2xRa0otRnpvVWJZN0d6NDVPM2U0SWFqajF6c3FKX3NmUTFncWxiYjZpLVd4VVNHVVNpUjF1V0R5V0U4eGJtUktULXZQRXJZdGJLa0RyRTQ5cnhtdHRfWjlzWkR6UXcxR0JZS3RqTGtySEVURHZEbmRqM3NNdjlVbVV2anliWnBaWHF0VVE)
- On the regulatory front, the Fed is seeking comments on stablecoin customer identification rules, while the U.S. housing market sees a bipartisan bill that may not immediately improve affordability. [Federal Reserve requests comment on stablecoin proposal](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20260618a.htm)

**Watch next:** The fallout from global chip stock volatility will dominate near-term trading, particularly for AI-linked equities. The ECB's June meeting minutes and consumer sentiment data out of Europe will test the 'sticky inflation' narrative. In China, watch for any policy response after Hong Kong stocks entered a bear market, and whether A-share turnover can sustain above 2 trillion yuan without triggering regulatory caution.

今日国际社会新闻呈现多重平行叙事：中东地区在美伊协议签署后出现短暂的通航回暖，但以色列与黎巴嫩边境的零星交火以及美伊核检查争端仍在为全面停火埋下隐患；欧洲大陆在极端热浪中遭遇系统性问题——德国铁路因IT故障全国瘫痪逾两小时，法国溺水死亡人数在四天内飙升至40人；东亚方面，韩国和日本股市因科技股抛售同步下挫，朝鲜最高领导人罕见点名批评日本“滑向战争国家”，韩流明星Mark因穿邦联旗衬衫引发争议后公开道歉；中国官方持续强化对台政策表述，国台办批评赖清德“穷途末路”；知乎在发布营收下滑23.6%的年度财报后，CEO周源明确将AI商业化定为下一阶段核心战略。
- [纽约民主党初选：马姆达尼支持的候选人横扫战场，布拉德·兰德击败丹·戈德曼，暴露了城市在加沙战争问题上的深刻分裂](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/clye652m41po)
- [美国国会数十年来首次通过战争权力决议，虽然象征意义大于实际，但加大了对白宫结束伊朗战争的施压](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ce8j6g3v3r4o)
- [以色列军队在黎巴嫩南部击毙两人，以方称其为真主党武装分子，真主党指责以色列违反停火协议](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c36ykpw0yego)
- [美伊协议签署后霍尔木兹海峡航运量猛增，仅周六就有42艘船只通过，但联合国同日宣布将撤离被困船员，鲁比奥警告伊朗不得征收“通行费”](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c24yr796emzo)
- [德国铁路因IT故障全国停运超过两个半小时，凸显关键基础设施对单一技术系统的脆弱依赖](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crm0ek4z7ggo)
- [法国自上周四以来已有40人因热浪相关溺水身亡，总理勒科尔努确认这一数字，欧洲高温峰值期仍在持续](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c79yvw3j114o)
- [朝鲜最高领导人批评日本正在演变为“战争国家”，日韩关系再添变数](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE10UGEzWE1hR05hZE9QcndhcDlJTk12VTluVzFlWjVGZkJmSzZYcVFoekZpUF9YRzZZWDRCTzY3Sl9fQVJSQ1dqMTg5WUptTTR2eDZ0dUROY0lRdw)
- [知乎2025年营收下滑23.6%，CEO周源表示将加速AI相关商业化探索，社区用户对内容价值与盈利模式的讨论升温](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ)

**后续观察：** 美伊协议的执行细节——特别是核检查权限和海峡通行费争议——可能在未来48小时内成为新的摩擦点；欧洲热浪与基础设施故障叠加，暴露出高温对交通和公共安全的系统性威胁；日韩股市的科技股抛售若延续，可能波及亚洲其他市场；知乎的AI转型方向值得关注，但社区对世界杯等热点内容的高度依赖也提示了平台在时效性与深度之间的平衡挑战。
society.en: The past 24 hours have been dominated by escalations and tentative de-escalations in the US-Iran conflict, with Congress passing a war powers resolution and dozens of ships returning to the Strait of Hormuz. In New York, a primary race laid bare deep divisions over Israel-Gaza policy, while Europe grappled with a deadly heatwave that has killed 40 in France. The World Cup continues to captivate, and China’s state media focused on educational and ideological messaging. Below, key developments by desk.

military.zh:
今日军事新闻聚焦三大战线：美国国会历史性地通过决议叫停对伊军事行动，乌克兰加强对克里米亚的无人机封锁切断俄军补给，以及印太地区美军启动大规模演习并加速向菲律宾移交无人系统。此外，中国航母福建号通过台湾海峡、日本再军事化引发中方警告，各国无人机采购与反制技术竞赛持续升温。

- **美国国会叫停伊朗战争**：参议院继众议院后通过决议，要求总统终止未经授权的军事行动，这是1973年《战争权力法》以来首次两院同时通过此类决议。[参考链接](https://www.defensenews.com/news/pentagon-congress/2026/06/24/us-senate-joins-house-in-voting-to-halt-iran-war/)
- **乌克兰打击克里米亚铁路桥**：乌军声称击中通往克里米亚的铁路桥，意图孤立俄占半岛，同时俄方加大无人机封锁。[参考链接](https://news.google.)
- **美军启动Valiant Shield与Resolute Dragon演习**：印太司令部主导，涉及关岛、马里亚纳群岛、日本等地，旨在强化联合全域作战能力。[参考链接](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/23/u-s-kicks-off-western-pacific-exercises-valiant-shield-resolute-dragon)
- **美向菲律宾移交无人水面/水下航行器**：四艘Ocean Aero Triton交付菲海军，并计划2027年前移交攻击型无人机，加强南海不对称威慑。[参考链接](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/23/u-s-asymmetric-aid-program-transfers-unmanned-vessels-to-the-philippines-plans-attack-drone-transfer-by-2027)
- **中国航母福建号穿越台湾海峡**：台湾“备战操演”期间，福建号通过台海，引发关注。[参考链接](https://news.google.)
- **波兰采购Shield AI V-Bat无人机**：用于海上作战，该机在乌克兰战场表现出抗电子战优势。[参考链接](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/06/poland-buys-v-bat-uavs-from-shield-ai-for-naval-forces/)
- **NATO与乌克兰悬赏开发破坏俄机场系统**：面向私营部门征集方案，旨在瘫痪俄空军基地。[参考链接](https://www.twz.com/news-features/nato-and-ukraine-turning-to-private-sector-to-help-crater-russian-airfields)
- **DARPA X-65无人机获翼即将试飞**：采用“射流控制”技术，无传统舵面，预计2027年首飞。[参考链接](https://www.twz.com/air/darpa-x-plane-designed-to-maneuver-with-just-bursts-of-air-finally-gets-its-wings)

**后续观察**：今日信息凸显两大趋势：一是美国国内对中东军事行动的立法约束加强，与印太地区军事部署的扩张形成对比；二是无人系统在乌克兰战场证明价值后正快速向全球扩散，从波兰到菲律宾都在加速列装。同时，中国航母常态化穿越台海表明解放军远海作战能力步入新阶段，台海与南海的博弈将更加依赖无人平台和不对称手段。
military.en:
The last 24 hours have been dominated by a landmark congressional vote to halt hostilities with Iran—a rare invocation of the War Powers Act—and by escalating multi-domain signaling across the Indo-Pacific, where the U.S. kicked off major exercises while China's Fujian carrier transited the Taiwan Strait. Meanwhile, the war in Ukraine continues to reshape global drone warfare, with fiber-optic killers appearing in Lebanon and new private-sector challenges to crater Russian airfields. Defense spending dilemmas, AI integration, and asymmetric naval strategies are converging as the primary narratives for decision-makers.

- **Iran War Powers Vote**: In an unprecedented move, the U.S. Senate joined the House to direct the president to remove forces from hostilities in Iran—the first such joint action since 1973 ([Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/news/pentagon-congress/2026/06/24/us-senate-joins-house-in-voting-to-halt-iran-war/)). The vote follows reports of an F-15E pilot encountering a “jellyfish-like” drone swarm over Iran before being downed ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/what-was-the-jellyfish-like-drone-swarm-the-downed-f-15e-pilot-reportedly-saw-over-iran)). The implications for defense stocks remain contested ([MSN](https://news.google.)).
- **Indo-Pacific Power Play**: The U.S. launched exercises [Valiant Shield 2026 and Resolute Dragon](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/23/u-s-kicks-off-western-pacific-exercises-valiant-shield-resolute-dragon) spanning Guam, the Marianas, and Japan. Simultaneously, China’s carrier *Fujian* transited the Taiwan Strait amid Taiwan’s “combat readiness” drill ([DW](https://news.google.)). The U.S. also transferred four Ocean Aero Triton autonomous vessels to the Philippines ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/23/u-s-asymmetric-aid-program-transfers-unmanned-vessels-to-the-philippines-plans-attack-drone-transfer-by-2027)).
- **Ukraine War Tech Diffusion**: Ukraine struck a key railway bridge to Crimea ([Washington Post](https://news.google.)). NATO and Ukraine are turning to private sector challenges to deny Russia use of its airfields ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/nato-and-ukraine-turning-to-private-sector-to-help-crater-russian-airfields)). Fiber-optic killer drones, first seen in Ukraine, have arrived in southern Lebanon, complicating Israeli operations ([Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/mideast-africa/2026/06/23/frustrating-israel-fiber-optic-killer-drone-technology-has-arrived-in-southern-lebanon/)).
- **Defense Spending & Industrial Base**: An analysis questions how much is too much for defense spending (Eurasia Review). The Navy is betting big on 3D printing to revive a dwindling casting and forging base ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/23/the-navys-big-3-d-printing-bet)). Poland’s purchase of V-Bat UAVs ([Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/06/poland-buys-v-bat-uavs-from-shield-ai-for-naval-forces/)) and the U.S. Marine Corps building an arsenal of “secret” aircraft carriers (19FortyFive) highlight rapid capability adoption.
- **AI and the Battlefield**: The Army is pioneering generative AI “Data Minutes” for multi-domain missions (Warrior Maven). DARPA’s X-65 air-maneuvering drone finally gets wings ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/darpa-x-plane-designed-to-maneuver-with-just-bursts-of-air-finally-gets-its-wings)). Shield AI’s V-BAT deal with Poland is a direct result of EW-resistant performance in Ukraine.
- **Chinese Military & Taiwan**: The Taiwan Affairs Office reiterated Beijing’s stance on non-renunciation of force after Lai Ching-te’s call to halt military expansion (Sohu). Taiwan’s opposition parties are cutting defense budgets, drawing U.S. criticism (Chosun). Alibaba is suing the Pentagon over its designation as a Chinese military company (WSJ).
- **European & Arctic Posture**: Hegseth is reviewing U.S. troop posture in Europe ([Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/06/behind-hegseths-european-posture-review-plus-a-big-cca-program-update/)). The Air Force’s “Fightertown Alaska” plan takes shape as Arctic and Pacific operations grow ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/air-forces-fightertown-alaska-plan-takes-shape)).

**Watch next**: The Iran peace deal’s impact on defense stocks and Middle East force posture; the outcome of the U.S.-Philippine asymmetric aid program as attack drones head to Manila by 2027; and the first flight of the DARPA X-65 drone next year. The convergence of war-tech diffusion from Ukraine to the Indo-Pacific will be the defining security trend of the coming quarter.

tech.zh:
### 科技新闻板块

今日科技圈呈现多重震荡：AI领域的人才争夺战白热化，谷歌痛失诺奖得主导致股价重挫；汽车产业电动化转型遭遇波折与机遇并存；而Amazon Prime Day则成为科技产品市场的绝对焦点，各大厂商借机清库存、推新品。编辑部梳理了以下关键动态：

- **AI人才大战升级**：Google DeepMind的诺贝尔奖得主（据信是Demis Hassabis或相关核心成员）被Anthropic挖角，直接引发[Alphabet股价暴跌5%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxPRF9KMkpGXzZfTFBrX1ViT1Nqdjk4djNJaG1QWGtVaDNyTHAxRHNvR0I1LS1HSGl2eVN4XzlkdDlaVjd6OVhCdzB0Uy0xVHpuOGhJZ1h2dnkwVnRkZEkySk5XLXd0YTZ6LTRaMmdjZ29vSjh4NUdwSTJzbmFkbXRxT20zWEZWakVOWFZSbXg2b0JQaElxa2ZEdHNQRzJPSVBj)。这一事件暴露了科技巨头在顶尖AI人才保留上的脆弱性，也显示Anthropic正通过“挖角+高薪”策略快速提升竞争力。
- **汽车行业冰火两重天**：比亚迪海外销量飙升，正通过[豪华电动车和插电式皮卡全面出海](https://electrek.co/2026/06/23/byd-unleashes-brand-power-overseas-luxury-evs-pickup/)；而法拉利首款纯电Luce因营销失当引发市场反感，[大中华区营销负责人被换](https://electrek.co/2026/06/23/ferrari-replaces-marketing-chief-luce-ev-backlash/)，显示传统豪车品牌电动化之路并非一帆风顺。
- **Prime Day提前引爆消费电子市场**：微软Surface Laptop降至$835的历史低价，Apple Watch Series 11及AirPods Pro 3均创新低，[Dyson全系产品大促](https://www.wired.com/story/prime-day-dyson-deals-2026/)，多家媒体同步推出精选清单，争夺消费者注意力。
- **Meta的挣扎与布局**：一方面传出Zuckerberg下令打造独立预测市场应用（试图摆脱对社交平台的依赖），另一方面其内部员工追踪计划因数据泄露而被迫暂停，显示出科技巨头在创新与隐私之间的两难。

**后续观察**：AI人才军备竞赛将加速行业洗牌——谷歌若不能稳住核心团队，其在基础模型领域的优势可能被Anthropic、OpenAI蚕食。汽车方面，中国品牌（比亚迪、吉利）通过高端化和多元化产品线，正在欧美市场撕开缺口，而传统巨头（丰田、大众）则需在供应链和需求下滑中寻找平衡。Prime Day的折扣力度预示消费电子需求疲软，厂商被迫以价换量，但消费者可趁此机会升级设备。
tech.en:
Today's tech landscape is dominated by a high-profile AI talent defection, internal corporate turmoil at Meta, and the irony of a climate conference cancelled by extreme weather. Meanwhile, automakers navigate EV launch backlash and geopolitical demand shocks, while Prime Day sales flood the consumer market. Here are the key stories from the past 24 hours:

- **AI talent war escalates:** Alphabet stock plunged ~5% after a Nobel Prize-winning DeepMind researcher jumped ship to Anthropic, per [Barron's](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxNSTc2Y1FPQno3bHpCdFJ5VXlzV0lzWFpsNFlKam5Hc2RnU1RxcXBmOWhpRUVISnJaXzh5Xzd4empiT3BKWFMxUlNOa2xSeVFxdTlyM21GVFdJcUZUU1hWd1VNekgtVU5JN3Rqak1mZFMtdXpaVjFkTXpuMi1KLU1RTHRQaFhSc0k3OFE) and [Axios](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE5SMzByMWZzTV9MNFdFTkk3YnBNZTBDaTU4ME1UaW1hbENPM3VONllGMUFXaXJkWXhoZHY4VTdnVXFwOTRJRGptQ1NoU0c4bGRuWkJmU1VBMEFrN3pQU1pneXNFMjVYMmNSNHQ0dmRpR3dpcGZSb2lTbTdR).
- **Meta's twin headaches:** The company paused an employee-tracking program after an internal data leak ([Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/meta-pauses-employee-tracking-program-following-internal-security-breach/)), while also reportedly plotting a standalone prediction market ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/23/mark-zuckerberg-wants-meta-to-launch-its-own-prediction-market/)).
- **Ferrari's EV stumble:** Ferrari replaced its long-serving marketing chief after the Luce EV launch wiped ~8% off its stock in a single day ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/23/ferrari-replaces-marketing-chief-luce-ev-backlash/)).
- **Toyota cuts output abroad** as the Iran war crimps demand, reports [Nikkei Asia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxOanZjVTRhMWhDUDlXWTc4cHhnZTBqVzRhck43Z0NVWWFsaE1fSU9xZTA0Y2FuSWlycmFkSVptd1F1TnhTalNsenQ5RFlVQV9nRWJrR0NOdXFRYnZOTlZtVUh1MEhHMHRRQjR0cjh4Nnp2SjZmVHJpYXY4NWZBV1c3ZTdhOEZfOWR5bndVY0d6UjNSSWFNYTJhdDZOM1M0VEVENmZmd0ltamxWLXpPOWIw).
- **Lucid Gravity GT review:** Drives like a dream with best-in-class efficiency but is plagued by software issues ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/23/lucid-gravity-2026-review/)).
- **BYD accelerates overseas** with luxury EVs and a plug-in pickup, signaling aggressive global expansion ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/23/byd-unleashes-brand-power-overseas-luxury-evs-pickup/)).
- **Irony of the day:** An 'Extreme Heat' conference at LSE was cancelled due to an extreme heat warning, drawing massive community engagement on Hacker News ([LSE](https://www.lse.ac.uk/granthaminstitute/events/extreme-heat-improving-governance-and-strengthening-action-around-the-world/)).
- **Google fired employee for creating a CLI tool** for Google Workspace, sparking widespread debate on autonomy and developer relations ([Twitter/X](https://xcancel.com/JPoehnelt/status/2069482265953087602)).

**Watch next:** The AI talent war will intensify as Anthropic continues to poach from big tech; watch for Meta's prediction market launch details; and keep an eye on automaker response to geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. Prime Day sales data tomorrow may also reveal consumer spending trends.

sports.zh:
世界杯小组赛战火正酣，英格兰0-0闷平加纳暴露进攻乏力，赛后贝林厄姆与对方教练冲突引发热议；C罗则在葡萄牙比赛中创纪录成为首位六届世界杯进球者。女足转会市场迎来历史性交易——19岁瑞典新星施罗德以破纪录身价加盟皇马。虎扑社区围绕世界杯展开激烈讨论，姆巴佩梅开二度、神评集锦等话题热度飙升。国内篮球方面，王俊杰确认回归CBA引发多队争抢，但体育信息环境中充斥着大量低质广告内容，需读者警惕。

- 英格兰的“现实检验”：继首场大胜克罗地亚后，三狮军团面对加纳的密集防守破门乏术，[0-0闷平](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/videos/c04yqexwpn0o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)让外界清醒。评论员指出这并非恐慌时刻，但进攻套路单一的问题暴露无遗。争议焦点在于英格兰是否应被判点球——有媒体嘲讽“VAR去喝咖啡了”。比赛前还出现[斯彭斯疑似拒绝与托马斯·帕尔特伊握手](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cg4w21g45zyo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)的插曲，为后续比赛埋下隐患。

- 贝林厄姆与奎罗斯冲突升级：英格兰主帅图赫尔赛后为爱徒辩护，称对方[“愚蠢的铲球+糟糕的反应”](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ce8k4zr6l2no?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)点燃了火药桶。这场口角让外界重新关注贝林厄姆的情绪管理问题，图赫尔需要尽快稳定军心。

- C罗再写传奇：37岁的葡萄牙巨星在小组赛中破门，成为[首位在六届世界杯均有进球的球员](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/clyx746enj9o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)，赛后高呼“我回来了”，回击了所有质疑者。他的表现让葡萄牙夺冠赔率进一步走低。

- 女足转会里程碑：皇马激活了厄勒布鲁19岁前锋[费利西亚·施罗德](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c0lyk13989ro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)的解约金，这笔交易成为女足史上最贵转会。这标志着欧洲女足军备竞赛进入新阶段，皇马希望借此缩小与巴萨、里昂的差距。

- 世界杯赛制公平性遭质疑：随着多支球队提前出局——目前已有[8支球队失去出线希望](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cdejryxlkxro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)，最后一场小组赛可能沦为垃圾时间。国际足联安排的“补水暂停”被质疑是商业行为，但因凡蒂诺坚称[“纯粹体育原因”](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c1ly8emz4n1o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)，且不会带来额外收入。

**后续观察**：英格兰的进攻问题将在淘汰赛前成为图赫尔的首要课题；C罗能否延续历史级状态值得期待；女足转会纪录的后续连锁反应（如其他俱乐部跟风抬价）需要关注；世界杯小组赛末轮的“默契球”风险将考验公平竞赛准则。
sports.en:
The last 24 hours in sports have been dominated by World Cup drama, with England stumbling to a goalless draw against Ghana, Cristiano Ronaldo etching his name further into history, and debates simmering over tournament integrity and officiating. Outside the pitch, a record-breaking women's football transfer, fresh community reactions from Chinese fans, and the start of a CBA free-agency battle round out a packed day.

- England's flat 0–0 draw with Ghana sparked frustration and a reality-check commentary from Phil McNulty, with questions over Jude Bellingham's heated row with Ghana coach Carlos Queiroz and a possible penalty not given by VAR. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c5yzv7wl00xo), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ce8k4zr6l2no), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cd6e3gvnnzwo))
- Cristiano Ronaldo became the first player to score at six World Cups, telling critics "I'm back" after Portugal's win. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/clyx746enj9o))
- FIFA president Gianni Infantino clarified that World Cup hydration breaks are "purely a sporting matter" and generate no extra revenue. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c1ly8emz4n1o))
- Real Madrid signed BK Häcken teenager Felicia Schroeder in what is reported as the most expensive transfer in women's football history. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c0lyk13989ro))
- A growing number of teams (eight) have nothing left to play for in the World Cup group stage, raising questions about the fairness of the new format. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cdejryxlkxro))
- On Chinese sports community Hupu, Kylian Mbappé's brace in France's 3–1 win over Senegal drew widespread celebration, while fans also dissected a rumoured Real Madrid bid for Schlotterbeck. ([虎扑](https://news.google.), [虎扑](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE1IWmRPUm94TUFUS0NTbDYybHNBM0U4SGtSSjhuNHRkeDhnMGUwTlAxQnJpTEVXU1NtWFliR1pWVkRoYWtnM3JTR3pwNmZlUTFxM1FNdXpoUjJqUUxpNS16b3VTN19xNHdCaFNUay12RHlXQQ))
- In Chinese basketball, forward Wang Junjie is set to return to the CBA, with four teams reportedly competing for his signing. ([Sina Sports](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE93NDhoc1VIMThJdU5aNFJrcWRUenYwbHFUcU15X0VPaTJlT0lIcEJSLVkyVDVhZ3NhUkYtTl82ejhXLXpyR3d5NENTeWZXNFYzNUtPUzdnT1Z6MXVNT1QtQktSMHA0OHhBZlFNdS05RnZXMnNxRkJZ))

**Watch next:** All eyes turn to the final round of World Cup group-stage matches, where the risk of dead rubbers looms large. Meanwhile, the women's football transfer market may heat up further after Real Madrid's record move, and CBA teams will continue jockeying for Wang Junjie's signature.

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐头条风云激荡。欧美音乐界失去一位巨人——传奇制作人Clive Davis去世，多位巨星发文悼念；与此同时，AI技术加速入侵影视创作，从日本导演是枝裕和到印度Eros Innovation，都在探索智能内容。日韩方面，BTS新曲《Come Over》创下Billboard纪录，韩剧市场则迎来多部新作定档。中国影视行业遭遇资本寒流，院线股暴跌，但动画《镖人2》开播以及白玉兰论坛的“电视+”倡议仍带来希望。微博社区则被孙俪本名曝光、王俊凯变脸、刘宇宁“叫宝宝”等话题刷屏，明星署名新规7月实施引发连锁讨论。

- [Clive Davis去世，Rob Thomas撰文悼念](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-features/rob-thomas-clive-davis-tribute-essay-1235582736/) 和 [Alicia Keys发文缅怀](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/clive-davis-dead-alicia-keys-tribute-1235582874/)，标志音乐界一个时代的终结。
- [是枝裕和新片《Sheep in the Box》首支预告发布](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/sheep-in-the-box-neon-trailer-hirokazu-koreeda-ai-drama-1236629132/)，AI代身家庭伦理成Cannes热议话题。
- [Eros Innovation推出AI音乐厂牌](https://deadline.com/2026/06/eros-innovation-mohammed-rafi-ai-music-label-jordan-tanu-1236964944/)，签约已故传奇歌手Mohammed Rafi家族，AI明星与真人版权博弈升级。
- [BTS新歌《Come Over》空降Billboard数字歌曲榜冠军](https://www.soompi.com/article/1849971wpp/btss-come-over-breaks-more-than-one-billboard-record-as-it-debuts-on-hot-100)，并打破多项纪录。
- [韩剧《My Bias, My Boss》宣布定档](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850013wpp/watch-kang-hoon-kim-hye-joon-cha-woo-min-and-itzys-yunas-new-drama-my-bias-my-boss-announces-premiere-date)，ITZY Yuna主演引发粉丝期待。
- [中国电影逼近跌停，影视院线板块早盘走弱](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTFBoNXFGNW42TWhfYnN6ZGtETmVYVXFTYXJLQkhPbi10ajBrcmwwY0sybldGaFUxNmh2ZnhKemhSWGlFVVROcTBzU1J0MA)，资本寒冬信号明显。
- [动画《镖人2》开播](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWEFVX3lxTE1TaDFtUGR2LTdPVTNsQ0ljRjhvc3QydlJFaHY3d2I1ZDg5NHhpby0wc0Z1RXdXblhHVzNBUjdFYjRBSk1QWTJ6eGlwclNFeUtsZHY0aXZueVo)，热血江湖融入宏大叙事，国漫口碑向好。
- [孙俪本名因演员署名新规登热搜](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE5yeDBEWEQtVzR4enROaTZMZ0thWHB3T2VKRWpUcnBJNVNpbGx2c0NNRWVOeVRjSnYzaXgtdVdpV3Rjd0tHMkpnVTRhWFFRNGQ5d1BDVzRmX3luRnliSWQ0WtIBZkFVX3lxTE5OdFZ2NHRFXzQ4NTBaYnVMOWtuV29Rd29yQm84X0E1dkV0R2FnVjFTWVdieUMzTXB3X0g2WEdfd3VRM2pOU0JyZko0aHRTMmpuaC1IbjE3Z2t2OUM0bUh2amVBY0NEQQ)，政策细微变动即引爆公众对艺人真实身份的关注。

**后续观察**：Clive Davis的离世标志着一个音乐时代的终结，其遗产可能影响未来唱片业权力结构；AI演员与真人明星的共生关系将成长期议题；中国影视股的暴跌是否预示着行业洗牌加速？微博上关于演员署名的争论，可能倒逼行业透明度提升。
entertainment.en:
The entertainment landscape this past 24 hours is marked by a convergence of AI disruption, industry introspection, and viral social media moments. From Hollywood mourning the loss of music titan Clive Davis to Chinese film stocks tumbling amid regulatory shifts, and K-pop idols breaking Billboard records, the signals are diverse yet interconnected. The rapid adoption of AI in content creation (Eros Innovation launching AI-native artists, Kore-eda's AI family drama) signals a structural shift that affects creators, consumers, and investors globally. Meanwhile, domestic (Chinese) entertainment faces a double blow of market panic and new actor-naming regulations, while social media remains the battleground for celebrity branding and public discourse.

- **Music mogul Clive Davis remembered** by Rob Thomas and Alicia Keys in heartfelt tributes, marking the end of an era for the record industry ([Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-features/rob-thomas-clive-davis-tribute-essay-1235582736/), [Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/clive-davis-dead-alicia-keys-tribute-1235582874/)).
- **AI music label goes live** as Eros Innovation launches seven AI artists and a Mohammed Rafi AI experience, signaling a new business model for legacy IP ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/eros-innovation-mohammed-rafi-ai-music-label-jordan-tanu-1236964944/)).
- **Hirokazu Kore-eda's 'Sheep in the Box'** gets its first trailer – a Palme d'Or winner's take on an AI-powered android replacing a deceased son, opening July 17 ([THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/sheep-in-the-box-neon-trailer-hirokazu-koreeda-ai-drama-1236629132/)).
- **Chinese film sector under pressure**: 'China Film' stock neared limit down as the market opens to a bearish sentiment, while the 'White Magnolia Forum' calls for 'TV+' innovation ([Sina Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxNWnF6VXJ6eU1udWFWYUczNi1jeXY4bno2UnJPeUNwNEhHYTlaSTdOYWw3MTk4VjN1NHhJZWR1QlhiNENidkJob0V4ZTRHSl9CMlJCclp2NTgtRUlvTmVOUVNqZnVNSk5KU2FaaUNYRlpFdU9MQW9uSWljQmRadll2Tnp0NTNkNFp2T1E), [China Youth Net](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZkFVX3lxTE5fZ2lPTVRnUG1fNVZQNlFibFVBUS0xR21xamdYOGFjelptUnMtSXgxUmhGU2ttYlVsUVZCMTdBbDU2c1QwWGc4dVVHcGRRNXVPRzdpNDRJaHEyUWZZNHFwcF9XZGhKdw)).
- **BTS's 'Come Over' debuts at No.1 on Billboard Digital Song Sales**, breaking multiple records ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1849971wpp/btss-come-over-breaks-more-than-one-billboard-record-as-it-debuts-on-hot-100)).
- **New Chinese actor-naming rule** triggers social media storm: Sun Li's real name trends after regulation requiring stage name disclosure ([Oriental Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE1wUnBQX0pVYi14RUtkTlRqdUQ1ekVWcE52MWlVSzd1TkgyMVhuSTZMX1NLNUk1UDJLYmc4VDEzTnMyanlQYU92SThFejRXY2NJZC04eWVQVUFGa2FSWnVRVnNJejN6ZUM3eTVCeENVNTU1eWFOdnlXZw)).
- **Larry David blasts Trump's White House UFC fight** as 'a travesty', while his new HBO show marks America's 250th birthday ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/columns/larry-david-barack-obama-hbo-trumps-white-house-ufc-fight-1236788700/)).
- **StubHub UK ordered to refund 50,000 customers** over illegal hidden fees, a regulatory win for ticket buyers ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cd6enx152jlo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)).

**Watch next:** Keep an eye on the July 17 release of 'Sheep in the Box' as a bellwether for AI-themed storytelling; the Chinese film market's response to policy changes; and whether BTS can extend its chart dominance into a second week. The debut of Eros Innovation's AI artists will test consumer appetite for synthetic pop stars.

美股.zh:
**概览**：隔夜美股科技股遭重挫，Cerebras暴跌与芯片板块联动引发亚洲市场补跌，但期货盘前反弹暗示抄底资金入场。道指成分调整与SpaceX债务融资成为结构性催化剂。

- [Cerebras首份财报利润率不及预期](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/23/cerebras-cbrs-q1-earnings-report-2026.html)，股价大跌10%，市场对纯AI芯片公司盈利模式疑虑加深。
- [Alphabet替代Verizon进入道琼斯工业平均指数](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/23/alphabet-verizon-dow-djia.html)，进一步强化科技对指数走势的支配力。
- [VIX指数母公司Cboe推出预测市场产品](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/24/vix-owner-cboe-jumps-into-prediction-markets-to-build-on-0dte-growth.html)，试图将零日期权热潮变现。
- [SpaceX通过债务融资250亿美元](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/23/spacex-debt-bond-market-ipo.html)，认购9倍，显示资金对前沿科技信用的渴求。
- MSCI在年中评审中[维持韩国新兴市场地位](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/24/msci-south-korea-emerging-market-indonesia-review-extended.html)，延迟印尼评审，新兴市场资金面临再平衡压力。

**收束**：科技股估值分歧短期难以弥合，但SpaceX巨额融资和道指换血表明资金仍在积极布局长线赛道。纽约初选结果可能影响市场对财政政策的预期。
美股.en:
U.S. equity futures edged higher after a brutal tech-led selloff, as investors digested mixed signals from earnings and politics. Alphabet's inclusion in the Dow and Cboe's prediction-market launch highlight structural shifts, while the New York primaries could reshape fiscal policy expectations. The Fed is also tightening oversight on stablecoins.

- Futures rose after the Nasdaq's worst day in months, with attention on chip stocks like Cerebras (-10%) and memory makers. [Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq Futures Rise After Chip Stock Selloff](https://news.google.)
- Alphabet will replace Verizon in the Dow, a rebalancing that reflects the dominance of tech in the economy but also raises index volatility risks. [Alphabet added to Dow Jones Industrial Average](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/23/alphabet-verizon-dow-djia.html)
- SpaceX's massive $25 billion debt raise (with $90 billion in orders) signals that even high-yield markets remain open for marquee names, possibly crowding out smaller issuers. [SpaceX raises $25 billion in debt sale](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/23/spacex-debt-bond-market-ipo.html)
- New York primaries saw three Mamdani-backed Democrats win House seats, while two incumbents lost – a sign that progressive economic policies could gain legislative traction. [Three New York Democrats backed by Mamdani win](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/24/mamdani-democrats-house-primary-lander-valdez-chevalier.html)
- The Fed proposed requiring stablecoin issuers to maintain customer identification programs, a move that could reshape the crypto and payments landscape. [Federal Reserve requests comment on stablecoin proposal](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20260618a.htm)

Markets will remain sensitive to tech earnings and Fed speak, with the primary election outcomes adding a new uncertainty to fiscal and housing policy.

欧洲经济.zh:
**概览**：欧洲股市延续跌势，通胀顽固与消费萎缩形成双重压制。数字欧元取得立法突破，但结构性改革仍任重道远。

- [ECB首席经济学家Lane警告](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxNcGYxbzRqVFlMdjFzLXJBbWF4QWttRGRhS3ptck9XNHZHOUZaQUl6My1LNGJRcVZXTmVoLXZsblpkM191UTk4QWJ5RHVlZ054bXNVMGpYSUYwR1JlaU5IMzBCT2ZQRG9tNlpnejV0LTg2cUlCVmRrUVFPMmxnSkhFV1d2cWk3NlF0MmFxRkxROEg0M1JjdkpuRklFNXZPTjdrTkZDc2Nxd25fTndtYUR0OUVfbWdJTWw4eVJYclhoQ3dzSlowS3Rxag)即使地缘紧张缓和，欧元区通胀仍可能高位运行。
- [WSJ报道欧洲消费者因恐惧不愿花钱](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxNVzktaU5FeG1nNnlsekpvN1hjWEVtMWtnY0Z0eWRaNUZuYXk5c204R1A3TFNSRVdRVWZ6M3RIQlZwaE9QZ2dlMjZrOFFtNnNzNGxfUkxsVXpfWUVyaElmTWN6NnVRLUJvTVZ3T1BzU29fT2FyQm9LNDBtcmlKLXNFODZzODFjZkVBWktjQ2lUYmdxRXAtbENlNEFDOXptdzNtb29WSHRCZEpKa2hxWTJmUw)，内需对经济拖累加剧。
- [数字欧元清除关键立法障碍](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxOTFJRQ2FQNjFwNHNoTWZGZ1pvQXZlY2Rib1ZvanNjdDZleU9hTVJVT29UbnNxNDJ1NUlZYldUVGhQUlU3WVhyaUlFRFlYR1YxVGVCMlN6MzU0YlZjQ0h5Sm4yUTRZV1Bldm9uaEthQkF4aDNpc1lGTlVlNTBPbjdyb0owdnp0RW5XNVZMamhPWHh1RzNvRXV5RU9nWEs4bzVGOUVDSTlqWkNYUQ)，欧盟加速摆脱对美元信用卡体系依赖。
- [石油冲击为全球经济增添压力](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxPT0dHbXRoRmUxQ0d2U19SODVtLURyQU5tMWhQSjh6cl9SaDRybGVJQ0Y1aXNuUkl3WlpPb2FLY1JGYlFIZS1xNmFCbEk4QUFyZXFYdll2akFOdU9pcEtoLWgza1E4TmdXZlBXNnYtNklYNGlEaDF3bHY5TXZOSVp1UkdoY1RxZw)，能源成本高企进一步抑制欧洲消费与工业生产。

**收束**：欧洲面临“滞胀”风险升温，ECB陷于两难。数字欧元虽加速，但短期难以扭转美元主导格局，区内经济分化值得持续关注。
欧洲经济.en:
European stocks slipped in sympathy with the global selloff, while ECB officials pushed back against hopes for rapid rate cuts. Consumer confidence is collapsing, and Brexit continues to drain the UK economy. The digital euro cleared a key hurdle as Europe seeks to challenge U.S. payment dominance.

- ECB's Philip Lane said eurozone inflation could stay high even with a Middle East peace deal, forcing markets to price in a longer tightening cycle. [ECB Warns Eurozone Inflation May Stay High](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxNcGYxbzRqVFlMdjFzLXJBbWF4QWttRGRhS3ptck9XNHZHOUZaQUl6My1LNGJRcVZXTmVoLXZsblpkM191UTk4QWJ5RHVlZ054bXNVMGpYSUYwR1JlaU5IMzBCT2ZQRG9tNlpnejV0LTg2cUlCVmRrUVFPM2xnSkhFV1d2cWk3NlF0MmFxRkxROEg0M1JjdkpuRklFNXZPTjdrTkZDc2Nxd25fTndtYUR0OUVfbWdJTWw4eVJYclhoQ3dzSlowS3Rxag)
- A Wall Street Journal report highlights that 'Europeans Are Terrified of Spending Money,' a structural headwind to growth even as energy shocks abate. [Europeans Are Terrified of Spending Money](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxNVzktaU5FeG1nNnlsekpvN1hjWEVtMWtnY0Z0eWRaNUZuYXk5c204R1A3TFNSRVdRVWZ6M3RIQlZwaE9PZ2dlMjZrOFFtNnNzNGxfUkxsVXpfWUVyaElmTWN6NnVRLUJvTVZ3T1BzU29fT2FyQm9LNDBtcmlKLXNFODZzODFjZkVBWktjQ2lUYmdxRXAtbENlNEFDOXptdzNtb29WSHRCZEpKa2hxWTJmUw)
- The digital euro legislative package cleared a key hurdle, aiming to reduce dependency on Visa and Mastercard. [Digital euro clears key hurdle](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxOTFJRQ2FQNjFwNHNoTWZGZ1pvQXZlY2Rib1ZvanNjdDZleU9hTVJVT29UbnNxNDJ1NUlZYldUVGhQUlU3WVhyaUlFRFlYR1YxVGVCMlN6MzU0YlZjQ0h5Sm4yUTRZV1Bldm9uaEthQkF4aDNpc1lGTlVlNTBPbjdyb0owdnp0RW5XNVZMamhPWHh1RzNvRXV5RU9nWEs4bzVGOUVDSTlqWkNYUQ)
- France 24 reports 'significant damage' from Brexit a decade on, with trade frictions reducing UK GDP by an estimated 5-6%. ['Significant damage': How Brexit is still draining the UK economy](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxNeE0ySzBVbFlXNTE0OVNtQUVPTGZMNUIwUEllYUdpX0pZNDNBREFaS3VHNG1tclpJTWNYcWNQaV9ES0Z0azdMNkhaWUxkak9ZcXJWaGU5Qi1Xdy0tczBYdmlUQVoxRjRqZnFrUDlFSWFVYXpfanNlLVp0OGdKNmlXcVJDQ2M5RTVRUnp0ZFdLWi1ENU83amxVQXVDbTNjVUl3eHBsc1BqcnZRMjBaWnlvVHhyemU5dlZsQ19ZT0p5bGdCVHZLUzc2Sw)

Watch for ECB minutes and eurozone consumer confidence data to set the tone for rate expectations – inflation fears may keep yields elevated despite growth concerns.

中国经济.zh:
**概览**：A股逆势放量，但港股中资股因消费疲弱确认进入熊市，两极分化明显。科技自主与医疗AI出口成为结构性亮点。

- [港股中资股持续下跌，已进入熊市](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxQSlJuc1hrRzQxR2RJVjRTS3JJeU01RU90TnExNnZmcDFaR2xRa0otRnpvVWJZN0d6NDVPM2U0SWFqajF6c3FKX3NmUTFncWxiYjZpLVd4VVNHVVNpRjF1V0R5V0U4eGJtUktULXZQRXJZdGJLa0RyRTQ5cnhtdHRfWjlzWkR6UXcxR0JZS3RqTGtySEVURHZEbmRqM3NNdjlVbVV2anliWnBaWHF0VVE)，反映市场对居民消费能力回暖缺乏信心。
- 创业板方面，[A股成交额突破2万亿元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE5qWWVJNkJyTERmX3FGdjJ0MHN0dDZZVHZ1RGdEZVNqakNoNVhxTExPdm9rRGZFdVVJZzFUNUJHWGZWSjVCdms4QW1CQk9IdjB5elJr)，科创50大涨，资金聚焦半导体与PCB等科技硬件环节。
- [中国医疗AI取得突破](https://www.scmp.com/tech/article/3358087/chinas-medical-ai-breaks-ground-surgical-robot-wins-eu-approval-model-tops-benchmark)：上海微创医疗的手术机器人获欧盟CE认证，临床级AI模型在OpenAI基准测试中夺冠。
- [小红书启动香港IPO测试市场情绪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE5xUkcxRVA1NGtJTFBESTFZUGhWaXNqbzFLMGFLM29Udk1uMnVkbWV3c09SVG44cDd6eVpkN1EzUXpWNlJUbWlzRU9OY3dTWGhYYlZoamM1b0QxbW9Gd1FqckhXdDBMdnlyckVv)，若成功将提振新经济公司赴港融资信心。
- [银行业争相招募AI领导人才](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3358158/banks-are-rushing-recruit-ai-leadership-how-will-tech-be-implemented)，AWS高管预测监管与客户需求将加速金融AI化。

**收束**：短期A股与港股背离显示资金情绪分化，科技主线维持景气，但消费疲软制约整体指数空间。关注下周PMI数据能否扭转市场对盈利的悲观预期。
中国经济.en:
Chinese markets presented a split picture: mainland A-shares surged on AI and semiconductor enthusiasm, with turnover briefly hitting 2 trillion yuan, while Hong Kong-listed Chinese stocks extended their decline into bear-market territory. Medical AI milestones and Xiaohongshu's IPO plans added corporate news, but consumer spending woes weigh.

- A-share turnover surpassed 2 trillion yuan for the first time, driven by strong gains in the STAR 50 index and chip-related stocks like advanced packaging and PCB upstream. [A股成交额突破2万亿元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE5qWWVJNkJyTERmX3FGdjJ0MHN0dDZZVHZ1RGdEZVNqakNoNVhxTExPdm9rRGZFdVVJZzFUNUJHWGZWSjVCdms4QW1CQk9IdjB5elJr) This liquidity surge is concentrated in tech names, raising froth concerns.
- In contrast, Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index slipped into bear market territory, dragged down by Chinese property and consumer stocks. [Chinese stocks in Hong Kong extend slump to enter bear market](https://news.google.)
- China’s medical AI sector notched two wins: MicroPort's surgical robot won EU approval, and a Chinese clinical model topped OpenAI's benchmark. [China’s medical AI breaks ground](https://www.scmp.com/tech/article/3358087/chinas-medical-ai-breaks-ground-surgical-robot-wins-eu-approval-model-tops-benchmark) This signals export potential for Chinese medtech.
- Bloomberg reports that Xiaohongshu is testing market sentiment for a Hong Kong IPO, a potential bellwether for Chinese consumer tech listings. [Xiaohongshu tests market sentiment with Hong Kong IPO plans](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE5xUkcxRVA1NGtJTFBESTFZUGhWaXNqbzFLMGFLM29Udk1uMnVkbWV3c09SVG44cDd6eVpkN1EzUXpWNlJUbWlzRU9OY3dTWGhYYlZoamM1b0QxbW9Gd1FqckhXdDBMdnlyckVv)
- Banks are rushing to hire AI leadership, with AWS predicting deeper integration in finance. [Banks are rushing to recruit AI leadership](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3358158/banks-are-rushing-recruit-ai-leadership-how-will-tech-be-implemented)

The divergence between A-share exuberance and Hong Kong weakness suggests capital is rotating into mainland AI speculation rather than broad-based recovery – watch for regulatory pushback if turnover stays elevated.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
**概览**：社区活跃度骤升，A股放量突破2万亿后投资者情绪亢奋，但“小作文”逼退分析师与贵金属暴跌警示风险。AI题材继续主导追捧，而强制平仓事件引发合规讨论。

- [A股成交额首次突破3万亿元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9QUEM3SmZZOWV3VnNKRGI3Y29IU0VHQU9wSVcwU21qdzl6OTRSWnJxRmhuQmpFOWxyZHFYbGk3dG4xVGY5UWt6WFZqQkNTNHZTMzNhQzJCXzNINGs1c3c)（同花顺数据），创历史天量，资金跑步入场迹象明显。
- [独立分析师Jukan因“行情太荒谬”被小作文逼退](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9PQUtDd1U1dXo3VFlodS1wZjdMREdLQnNwTlAwYnVDMlBjQm00Zl9ycFF6QmxUb08tMFFWNjRzQm5hMGlnRXpKY0UxWVZoUUU5RFhoMXotOF9ac2ZJVXJoY2h3)，社区对信息真实性讨论激烈。
- [期货市场沪银跌超5%创阶段新低](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9YelhvSlJzZk00LXpkQlpKMlRMejBndzEwOEd0Mm40b0c3a1FEajNod1Uwd0ZZY3luN0ZaNnp5QkJUMTUyTnJCcU4zVzJjYm1GbG9mRDRZTnhHYXRScVE)，加息预期升温打压贵金属多头。
- [统联精密](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9KaGM2U0JIS084dGRsRFFrS1h0Sks5V1BNbFc4ank2bU1Da3hlOTIxeDRBTjZlS19mWWZIbmRYSndlYjJ5ekNYbUhWc25CajZ0ZFZEdk5udjdwX1phS0Fzc05B)与[挖金客](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE4wdktEZ2xKckd0S2doeHVsMmdSV2FySjBDZDlsVVVCekc3TERxTW40RFdLbThNeDMwQm9INmdZM2t1SkFRZFB5UjZxMnB1SHBBeHRSb0o0cW01TDFYVEVMbkNR)相继成立AI子公司，社区将之视为产业趋势加速信号。
- [欢瑞世纪股东被裁定最低2元抛970万股](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE43S1g0NklZajBDbXZVNzBKOTNvMU9jN05PNnZpTEh3dXplSUpJYTBiWHFEQUxVNFVzZldnbjRCN0pPQ2hnd1N1Y3dVb19qMG1hVnhvV3FEOVBMZ0ViZ3c)，强制平仓价格之低引发小股东恐慌和监管讨论。

**收束**：社区情绪短期偏多，但小作文干扰和贵金属暴跌暗示市场脆弱性。AI概念仍是资金最拥挤赛道，但需警惕业绩证伪后的踩踏风险。
同花顺社区动态.en:
The Chinese retail-investor community on Tonghuashun (同花顺) is buzzing with AI-related company formations and a dramatic exit by an independent analyst who cited 'absurd' market rumors. Turnover records and a sharp selloff in precious metals futures are also dominating discussion.

- Independent analyst Jukan announced he is quitting A-share analysis, citing 'absurd rumors' (小作文) that distort the market—a sign of growing frustration with manipulative narratives among retail participants. [A股“小作文”逼退独立分析师Jukan](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9PQUtDd1U1dXo3VFlodS1wZjdMREdLQnNwTlAwYnVDMlBjQm00Zl9ycFF6QmxUb08tMFFWNjRzQm5hMGlnRXpKY0UxWVZoUUU5RFhoMXotOF9ac2ZJVXJoY2h3)
- Two companies, 统联精密 (Unified Precision) and 挖金客 (Wajinke), set up new subsidiaries with AI-related business scopes, reflecting the corporate rush to label AI amid the stock surge. [统联精密在上海成立人工智能技术公司](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9KaGM2U0JIS084dGRsRFFrS1h0Sks5V1BNbFc4ank2bU1Da3hlOTIxeDRBTjZlS19mWWZIbmRYSndlYjJ5ekNYbUhWc25CajZ0ZFZEdk5udjdwX1phS0Fzc05B) [挖金客成立新公司，含多项AI相关业务](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE4wdktEZ2xKckd0S2doeHVsMmdSV2FySjBDZDlsVVVCekc3TERxTW40RFdLbThNeDMwQm9INmdZM2t1SkFRZFB5UjZxMnB1SHBBeHRSb0o0cW01TDFYVEVMbkNR)
- A-share turnover exceeded 3 trillion yuan for the first time, but community chatter is split between euphoria and skepticism about sustainability. [最新数字！首次，3万亿](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9QUEM3SmZZOWV3VnNKRGI3Y29IU0VHQU9wSVcwU21qdzl6OTRSWnJxRmhuQmpFOWxyZHFYbGk3dG4xVGY5UWt6WFZqQkNTNHZTMzNhQzJCXzNINGs1c3c)
- Precious metals futures slumped sharply, with silver down over 5% to new lows as rate-hike expectations rise—a common theme in retail forums. [期货午评：加息预期升温！贵金属持续下挫 沪银跌超5%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9YelhvSlJzZk00LXpkQlpKMlRMejBndzEwOEd0Mm40b0c3a1FEajNod1Uwd0ZZY3luN0ZaNnp5QkJUMTUyTnJCcU4zVzJjYm1GbG9mRDRZTnhHYXRScVE)

Community sentiment is increasingly polarized—watch for regulatory intervention if the retail frenzy escalates, and keep an eye on Jukan's departure as a potential canary for disillusionment with 'rumor-driven' trading.

欧美.zh:
今日欧美社会新闻聚焦中东冲突的局部缓和与欧洲内部的结构性危机。美国方面，纽约民主党初选中亲巴勒斯坦阵营取得压倒性胜利，国会通过象征性战争权力决议施压白宫；中东方面，美伊协议虽带动霍尔木兹海峡航运恢复，但以色列与黎巴嫩边境的枪声以及核检查争议提醒全面停火仍脆弱；欧洲则在极端热浪中暴露出基础设施短板。
- [纽约初选：马姆达尼支持的候选人横扫，兰德击败戈德曼，战争议题撕裂民主党](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/clye652m41po)
- [国会通过战争权力决议，首次以立法形式直接批评特朗普的伊朗战争](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ce8j6g3v3r4o)
- [以色列在黎南部击毙两人，双方相互指责违反停火](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c36ykpw0yego)
- [德国铁路IT故障致全国停运超两小时，暴露关键基础设施风险](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crm0ek4z7ggo)
- [法国热浪致40人溺水死亡，欧洲高温峰值仍在持续](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c79yvw3j114o)
收束：美伊协议带来的航运复苏与边境暴力并存，说明中东和平进程的脆弱性；欧洲热浪与IT故障的叠加效应值得持续追踪其对公共服务能力的考验。
欧美.en:
The US-Iran war remains the central story: Congress passed a largely symbolic war powers measure rebuking Trump, and the Strait of Hormuz saw 42 ships transit in a single day after the US-Iran deal, though nuclear inspection disputes threaten finalization. In New York, Brad Lander defeated Dan Goldman in a Democratic primary that exposed deep city divisions over Israel-Gaza. On the ground in Lebanon, Israel killed two men it called Hezbollah operatives, accused of a ceasefire violation. Domestically, eight people were sentenced to 450 years over an anti-ICE riot in Texas where an officer was shot, and Germany’s rail network suffered a nationwide IT failure for 2.5 hours. France reported 40 heatwave-related drownings since last Thursday. In other news, Bondi Beach shooting hero Ahmed pleaded not guilty to assault on his father.
- [Clean sweep for Mamdani-backed candidates in New York's Democratic primary](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/clye652m41po)
- [Congress passes war powers measure for first time, rebuking Trump's war with Iran](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ce8j6g3v3r4o)
- [Israeli troops kill two in south Lebanon after lull in fighting](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c36ykpw0yego)
- [Dozens of ships head through Strait of Hormuz after US-Iran deal](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx23rnzdgl8o)
- [Drowning deaths soar in France as Europe buckles in heatwave](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c79yvw3j114o)
Watch for: Whether the US-Iran nuclear inspections dispute will derail the final peace deal.

日韩.zh:

- [Mark因邦联旗衬衫争议公开道歉，韩流娱乐界的政治敏感度再受关注](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE51aTBVSmpsdTY5WkpQTnRrTm9qZ0VJbXNlRmZWRTNmZlU1T2hGQ21lTDBXQkU1c2EwMFJ1ZVhiNm12YU5CVFVvSWM4UzVFdzVBQzI3d295NA)

收束：朝鲜言论升级与韩国潜艇计划同步推进，日韩安全局势正从经济摩擦向军事对峙扩展；K-pop明星的文化失言事件则提示娱乐产业在全球政治极化中的高风险。
日韩.en:
Asian markets took a hit as tech stocks slumped, with South Korea's Kospi suffering its biggest selloff since March and Japanese stocks losing momentum. North Korean leader Kim Jong Un criticized Japan as turning into a 'war state', adding regional tension. Meanwhile, Japan's PM Takaichi decided to skip the NATO summit in July, while South Korea pushes a nuclear-powered submarine plan—both signs of diverging security postures. On the lighter side, K-pop star Mark apologized for a Confederate flag shirt controversy, and more South Koreans are traveling to Japan, widening the travel gap.

- [Kospi suffers biggest selloff since March](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTFBTTDAtTDRxMDlYNzFvSXZENEF1RFIyMlpXcnEyVEVXN2lRci1RN3dOa05aUEFobENzcG5vX2RYMkwxZmppaFotZFh0V0dxTHVnRlluSGx4RQ)
- [Takaichi to skip NATO summit in July](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxQYWpUTUpEMWZXM0xyWGVJYkZyZi1SekVmY1dHb2ZpcVRTYzJVRUN0S2NhcjVoR1Z1ZjN0enBCMnRRR05jVG1HQ3I3U3ctbHZ2OThFWEtYUEF2bFJwWTkxcW9CanVjY2dtYngyTXJ2NEx2NEFTS2pVZEJSdTNKUXBFcGE3bzFtM0V2dXQ4dS1KVQ)
- [South Korea pushes nuclear-powered submarine plan](https://news.google.)
Watch for: Whether deep tech selloff signals a regional recession risk, and how North Korea’s rhetoric impacts Japan-South Korea security cooperation.

中国.zh:
今日中国社会新闻以官方政策宣示和教育领域动态为主。国台办点名批评赖清德“对外叫嚣坐实台独陷入穷途末路”，措辞严厉；立陶宛总统接受政府辞呈，事件热度虽高但与中国关联尚待观察；此外多篇教育报道强调高质量党建和哲学社会科学发展，体现当前官方对意识形态阵地的持续投入。

收束：台海议题和立陶宛政局是今日中国社会新闻中少数具有国际影响的事件，教育领域的“党建引领”报道则反映了内部治理的常态化基调。
中国.en:
China’s state media amplified calls for implementing UN Security Council resolutions and reiterated opposition to Taiwan independence, with the Taiwan Affairs Office labeling Lai Ching-te's rhetoric as 'dead-end'. Domestically, President Xi’s educational and party-building messaging dominated—academics appointed to top university posts and calls for high-quality party-led development. 国际安全.en:
The international security landscape was reshaped by the U.S. Congress’s historic War Powers Act vote to halt hostilities in Iran—a move that signals deep unease over unauthorized conflict and could reshape military planning. At the same time, NATO and Ukraine are innovating through private-sector challenges to degrade Russian airfields, while fiber-optic killer drones exported from Ukraine’s battlefields now threaten Israeli operations in southern Lebanon. Defense spending dilemmas and AI integration continue to drive procurement and doctrine.

- U.S. Senate joins House in voting to direct the president to remove forces from Iran—first such use of War Powers Act since 1973 ([Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/news/pentagon-congress/2026/06/24/us-senate-joins-house-in-voting-to-halt-iran-war/)). The vote follows reports of a downed F-15E pilot seeing a ‘minefield of drones’ ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/what-was-the-jellyfish-like-drone-swarm-the-downed-f-15e-pilot-reportedly-saw-over-iran)).
- NATO and Ukraine launch a challenge offering rewards for systems to deny Russia use of its airfields ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/nato-and-ukraine-turning-to-private-sector-to-help-crater-russian-airfields)).
- Fiber-optic killer drone technology—previously seen in Ukraine—has arrived in southern Lebanon, frustrating Israeli operations ([Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/global/mideast-africa/2026/06/23/frustrating-israel-fiber-optic-killer-drone-technology-has-arrived-in-southern-lebanon/)).
- Pentagon chief Hegseth is reviewing U.S. troop posture in Europe while the CCA drone wingman program gets a major update ([Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/06/behind-hegseths-european-posture-review-plus-a-big-cca-program-update/)).
- DARPA’s X-65 x-plane, which maneuvers with air bursts, finally gets its wings and is set to fly next year ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/darpa-x-plane-designed-to-maneuver-with-just-bursts-of-air-finally-gets-its-wings)).

The message is clear: legislative brakes on executive war powers, combined with rapid technology diffusion from Ukraine, are fundamentally altering how the U.S. and its allies prepare for and authorize conflict.

中国军情.en:
China’s military posture continues to draw reactions across the Taiwan Strait and in the South China Sea, as the Fujian carrier transits the Taiwan Strait during Taiwan’s drills. In a significant legal fight, Alibaba is suing the U.S. Pentagon to be removed from the Chinese military company list. The Taiwan Affairs Office responded to Lai Ching-te’s call to halt military expansion by reiterating China’s stance on non-renunciation of force.

- Taiwan’s opposition parties are cutting defense budgets, prompting U.S. criticism that this is a concession to Beijing (Chosun).
- Alibaba filed a lawsuit against the Pentagon demanding removal from the ‘Chinese military companies’ list ([WSJ](https://news.google.)).
- China’s aircraft carrier Fujian transited the Taiwan Strait as Taiwan conducted combat readiness drills ([DW](https://news.google.)).
- The U.S. transferred solar-powered unmanned surface vessels to the Philippines to enhance South China Sea surveillance ([VOA](https://news.google.)).
- China’s foreign ministry criticized Japan’s re-militarization as a threat to regional stability (Phoenix News).

The combination of legal challenges by Chinese tech giants, military signaling near Taiwan, and U.S. counter-capability transfers to allies points to a deepening technology and sovereignty contest that could escalate into open confrontation.
